summary.headline: Salzer Q2 FY27 revenue rose 38.4% YoY to INR579.77 crores, but EBITDA margin compressed to 6.89% (8.73% last year); FY27 margin guided to around 8%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations was INR579.77 crores, up 38.4% YoY and 16.4% QoQ from INR498.02 crores. EBITDA excluding other income was INR39.95 crores at a 6.89% margin, versus 8.73% a year earlier and 6.29% in Q1, and PAT rose to INR14.87 crores. Management attributed the margin squeeze to copper, silver, aluminium and plastic cost inflation in Switchgear, with price revisions lagging pass-through, and expects progressive recovery in Q3 and Q4. Revenue guidance of about INR2,100 crores for FY27 was retained, and the Saudi Arabia plant start was pushed to April 2027 because of Middle East conflict.

financial_highlights.change: revenue +20.4% YoY; EBITDA margin about 50 bps lower YoY, about 125 bps higher QoQ

segments.name: Industrial Switchgear
segments.commentary: 56.39% of Q2 revenue and 55.09% of H1 (about INR580 crores in H1); Q2 YoY growth 23.79%, Q2 EBITDA margin 8.26%. Carries most of the margin pressure from raw material inflation. Utilisation about 80%.

segments.name: Wires & Cables
segments.commentary: 36.18% of Q2 revenue and 38.08% of H1; YoY change 57.48%, Q2 EBITDA margin 5.05%. Largely cost-plus with customers, so margins described as stable. Utilisation about 65%, with no major capacity investment planned near term.

segments.name: Building Products
segments.commentary: 7.43% of Q2 revenue and 6.82% of H1; Q2 YoY change 103.53%. Retail expanded beyond five southern states into Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha and Chhattisgarh.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: 23.6% of Q2 revenue (about 18.6% in Q1) and 21.29% of H1, versus about 24% a year earlier; absolute export growth about 11%. Medium-term target is about 25% of revenue.

segments.name: Smart meters (within Energy/Other)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue INR2.87 crores; about INR3 crores in Q2. Facility capacity 4 million units per annum; about INR50 crores invested; drag on EBITDA of 0.7-1% max; breakeven needs about INR25-30 crores per quarter.

segments.name: Associates and new businesses
segments.commentary: Effilume (49% stake) Bengaluru street light project of INR200 crores, expected to yield about INR2.2-2.25 crores per month, start delayed from Q3 FY27 to February 2027. UltraFast Chargers: about 85 chargers sold, about INR9 crores revenue this year.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance retained at about INR2,100 crores, roughly 30%+ YoY growth; no upgrade given.
FY27 EBITDA margin targeted at around 8% (an earlier-cited range of 7.5-8%), with margins normalising progressively from Q3 and Q4 if raw material prices stay stable; H2 needs above 8% to reach that.
FY28 EBITDA margin expected at around 9-10% in one answer and close to the 10% target in another.
Management expects Q3 and Q4 revenue to run at or above the Q2 level of about INR580 crores.

Saudi Arabia plant (INR15 crores all-inclusive cost, cable ducts and terminal connectors first): operations pushed from Sept-Oct 2026 to April 2027; first-year revenue about INR20 crores, rising to about INR100 crores in three years; breakeven in year two.
Effilume street light revenue start delayed to February 2027.
Working capital target of about 25% of revenue; NWC days expected to keep falling over the next six months.
Switchgear capacity balancing from FY28 for about 20-25% debottlenecking with modest capex; FY27 capex otherwise modest.
capex_capacity: Industrial Switchgear utilisation about 80%, described as sufficient for FY27 growth; balancing capex planned from FY28 to add about 20-25% capacity, described as not capex-heavy.
Wires & Cables utilisation about 65%; no major capacity investment expected near term.
Capital work in progress closing balance INR11 crores, relating to buildings and Switchgear equipment advances.
Smart meter facility fully integrated with 4 million units per annum capacity; about INR50 crores invested; order book remains weak.
Saudi Arabia plant: machinery installation now expected from January 2027, after earlier plan of August-September 2026.
demand_pricing: Management cited demand for Switchgear as healthy, with data centres, renewables and BESS as growth drivers through supplier relationships rather than direct supply.
Price revisions made in calibrated steps over several months; pass-through lags because revisions apply only to orders booked or executed. Management said customers resist price increases.
Management said Wire & Cable pricing is cost-plus, so margins were stable, and pressure sits mainly in Switchgear.
Copper prices stable with slight upward trend over 3-4 months; silver softening slightly. Management said a future copper decline would benefit margins with a lag.
No hedging of commodities so far, though the company is exploring it.
Tamil Nadu smart meter tender postponed to January or February 2027, per management.

qa_highlights.question: Will H2 EBITDA exceed 8% to deliver a 7.5-8% full-year margin, and which segments drive it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed the arithmetic. Wire & Cable margins are stable; the Switchgear margin hit is expected to reverse as price increases take effect in Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Will revenue guidance be raised given H1 growth of 25%?
qa_highlights.answer: No. The INR2,100 crore full-year guidance is retained, which implies about 30%+ YoY growth.

qa_highlights.question: Is hedging used for raw materials?
qa_highlights.answer: Hedging has been explored, but no projects or commodities have been hedged so far.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Saudi plant's investment, timeline and revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: INR15 crores all-inclusive, first-year revenue about INR20 crores, about INR100 crores in three years, breakeven in year two, operations from April 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What is the smart meter breakeven and drag?
qa_highlights.answer: Breakeven needs about INR25-30 crores quarterly revenue; EBITDA/PAT drag is about 0.7-1% maximum. Management has about INR50 crores invested in the business.

qa_highlights.question: What is the copper cost pass-through outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said stable copper helps, but the full pass-through of earlier increases is still under way; a later decline would benefit margins without a price cut.

risks_watch: Margin recovery depends on price revisions being realised, on raw material prices (copper, silver, aluminium, plastics) staying stable, and on customer acceptance.
Working capital intensity and rising borrowings; debt-to-equity 0.92x described as the highest in four years. Management declined to rule out a capital raise but said nothing is immediate.
Middle East conflict is delaying the Saudi Arabia plant to April 2027, with installation contingent on the situation settling.
Effilume Bengaluru project revenue delayed to February 2027 due to BBMP restructuring and agreements.
Smart meter order book is weak, with breakeven requiring about INR25-30 crores per quarter against about INR3 crores in Q2.
Export share fell to 21.29% in H1 from about 24% a year earlier, against a target of about 25%.
Switchgear capacity constraints from FY28 require balancing capex.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the medium-term story and the Q3-Q4 margin recovery, but cautious and somewhat qualitative on timing. Management repeatedly stressed that price increases lag realisation, and several answers on Saudi Arabia, Effilume and smart meters were delayed or left without numbers.
key_quotes: Subject to raw material prices remaining stable, we expect margins to normalize progressively from the third and the fourth quarter of this financial year, with the full year FY27 EBITDA margin around 8%.
I think there's a distinction between announcing a price increase and realizing it in the reported revenue.
We have explored the possibility of doing some hedging, but we have so far refrained hedging any projects, any commodity as of now.
We are not directly going into the utilities to execute the project. I think we are only a manufacturer.

adds.what: Saudi Arabia plant (cable ducts and terminal connectors first), INR15 crores all-inclusive cost
Switchgear balancing/debottlenecking, about 20-25% capacity add with modest capex
Effilume Bengaluru street light project, INR200 crores (49% associate), yielding about INR2.2-2.25 crores per month

growth.why: FY27 revenue guidance of about INR2,100 crores (roughly 30%+ YoY) was held, with H1 at INR1,077.79 crores (+25.3%) implying a strong H2 that management backs with Switchgear utilisation at ~80% and demand from data centres, renewables and BESS, but no specific new order book numbers were given; the Saudi plant slipped to April 2027 and the Switchgear expansion is only from FY28.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin 6.89% (vs 6.29% in Q1, 8.73% a year ago); management guides FY27 around 8%, requiring H2 above 8%, with Switchgear price revisions flowing through and Wire & Cable margins stable at 5.05%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Switchgear utilisation at about 80% with balancing capex adding 20-25% capacity from FY28; Saudi plant slipped to April 2027 (INR15 crore cost) and Effilume's INR200 crore project to February 2027.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management holds FY27 revenue at about INR2,100 crore (30%+ YoY) and expects Q3 and Q4 at or above Q2's about INR580 crore, after H1 growth of 25.3% to INR1,077.79 crore.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Switchgear utilisation about 80% is described as sufficient for FY27 growth; the balancing capex of 20-25% capacity is planned from FY28, though management calls it not capex-heavy and says no major capex is expected in other infrastructure.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management explicitly kept FY27 revenue guidance at about INR2,100 crore with no upgrade, and cut the FY27 EBITDA margin view to around 8% from an earlier 7.5-8% range... (margin range was stated as 7.5-8% earlier, so no upgrade signal).

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Margin recovery depends on price revisions being realised and on copper, silver, aluminium and plastic costs staying stable; Q2 margin of 6.89% is well below the ~8% needed in H2.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Saudi Arabia plant (cable ducts and terminal connectors first) starts April 2027 with first-year revenue about INR20 crore; UltraFast Chargers at about 85 units sold and about INR9 crore revenue this year.

rows.label: Working capital and debt pressure
rows.why: NWC days fell to 135 from 153 (March 2026) with a target of about 25% of revenue, but debt-to-equity is 0.92x, the highest in four years, and management did not rule out a capital raise.

rows.label: Export share recovery
rows.why: Export share fell to 21.29% of H1 revenue from about 24% a year earlier, against a medium-term target of about 25%, with absolute export growth only about 11%.

rows.label: Tamil Nadu smart meter tender
rows.why: Tender postponed; smart meter revenue is about INR3 crore a quarter against the INR25-30 crore needed for breakeven, with INR50 crore invested.

tone.note: Management was confident on the medium-term story and the Q3-Q4 margin recovery, but cautious on timing and repeatedly stressed price-pass-through lag; analysts pushed on the H2 margin arithmetic, the guidance held at INR2,100 crore, and the Saudi, Effilume and smart meter delays.

quality.why: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 38.4% YoY to INR579.77 crores, with Switchgear up 23.79% and Wires & Cables up 57.48% on the back of capacity utilisation rising to about 80% in Switchgear; the brief cites no one-off gains, losses, or weak base, though margin pressure (EBITDA margin 6.89% vs 8.73%) reflects input costs rather than growth quality.
